solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       COUNT(*)::integer AS shipments,
       ROUND(AVG(weight_kg))::integer AS avg_kg
FROM shipments
WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY customer_id;
notes: Customer 6 average 899.5 rounds up to 900, the same tie rule as c6-i4. Shipment counts include the NULL-weight rows, giving 40 per customer.
